name: Sushi Roll
notes: Work-list address 1187 Broadway (actually Chula Vista, CA per the restaurants own site/Toast/DoorDash, though listed under San Diego on this work list - confirmed matching restaurant via exact street address on multiple sources). This is a US location of the Mexican Sushi Roll chain. Own Toast storefront (order.toasttab.com/online/sushi-roll-187-broadway) only holds restaurant metadata server-side - the paginatedMenuItems query returned 0 items (client-fetched), so DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD (schema.org Menu, server-rendered) was used instead - tier 3, medium. Markup check: 28 unique prices tested against 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30 divisors, no consistent landing on round or .95 values at any divisor (best was 3/28 at 1.20) - passes, looks like organic restaurant pricing, not a platform markup. The Most Ordered carousel (12 items) was diffed against the categorized sections: 6 of its items (California Roll, Philadelphia Roll, Spicy Tuna Roll, Super Crunch Roll, Shrimp Tempura Roll, Salmon Avocado Roll) do not appear anywhere in the 15 named sections and were kept under a Rolls section; the other 6 were exact name+price duplicates and dropped. Grubhub was tried for a cross-check but returned only a thin bot-shell page with no usable data in the time available. Sections reached: Cocktail No Alcohol, Water, Appetizers, Nigiri, Temaki/Hand Roll, Ramen, Sashimi, Los Tiraditos, Courses, Soup, Salads, Tempura, Poke Bowl, Special Rolls, plus recovered Rolls - looks like a complete a-la-carte menu for a sushi restaurant.

notes: Address confirmed: page lists Tierrasanta Blvd Suite H, matching work-list 10645 Tierrasanta Boulevard #H (this Wix site also covers a sister La Mesa location, distinguished by separate Clover ordering links - the Tierrasanta location prices were read from the sites own /menu page, not the sister). This is the restaurants own Wix-hosted menu (Wix Restaurants widget, data-hook=item.name/item.price/item.priceVariants), single Menu tab (no hidden dayparts - only one ?menu=menu tab exists). 238 priced rows across all 15 sections shown (Appetizers/Starters, Noodles, Soups, Entrees, Bowls, Fried Rice, Bentos, Sashimi & Nigiri Combos, Nigiri & Sashimi, Specialty Sushi Rolls, Hand Rolls, Salads, Rolls, Desserts, Drinks) - full a la carte menu including nigiri/sashimi per-piece pricing (expanded from item.priceVariants into separate priced rows, e.g. Salmon (Nigiri) / Salmon (Sashimi)). One item, Ramen, was dropped: its only listed choices are free broth modifiers with no base price anywhere in the markup. Two Clover online-ordering links exist on the homepage (tappi-sushi-2-san-diego for this location, tappi--sushi--grill-la-mesa for the sister) but both redirect to the cloveronline.com COLO2 React SPA with no server-rendered data - not needed here since the own-site menu was complete and priced.

name: The Boba Co.
notes: Restaurants own site (thebobaco.com) is itself Square Online-hosted (custom_domain mapped to a *.square.site subdomain) and is a pure client-rendered React SPA - the homepage HTML has no nav links or catalog data, so it was handed off. Used order.online instead, per playbook: full menu recovered from the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push chunks), which held both the MenuBookCategory count list and 9 complete MenuPageItemList blocks. Every categorys extracted item count matched its declared numItems exactly (Milk Teas 8/8, Premium Milk Teas 5/5, Fruit Teas 9/9, Matcha 5/5, Fruit Milks 5/5, Butterfly Juices 6/6, Plain Tea 2/2, Items 4/4) - complete capture, not a sample. Address confirmed: 13526 Poway Rd, Poway, CA 92064 matches work list. Most Ordered carousel (10 items) diffed against categorized items - all 10 were exact name+price duplicates and dropped. One merch item (The Boba Co. Snapback Hat, 0.00) was excluded as non-food. Markup check: 9 unique prices against 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25 divisors found no consistent round-number landing - passes, looks like real pricing not a platform markup. Sections: Milk Teas, Premium Milk Teas, Fruit Teas, Matcha, Fruit Milks, Butterfly Juices, Plain Tea, Items (3 seasonal-style drinks) - small drink-only shop, this is likely the complete menu.

name: James Coffee Co
blocked: The work-list location (2355 India St, Little Italy) is temporarily closed for construction - the restaurants own locations page says Little Italy RE-OPENING 2026. During construction they are running a stripped-down pop-up at 2360 India St (inside Craftmossphere) - its order.online listing (order.online/store/james-coffee-san-diego-24807705) explicitly says 2360 India St temporarily during our construction! and its menu is only 4 items (Specialty Espresso x3, Tea & Soda x1), clearly not the normal cafe menu, so it was not used as a substitute per the one-locations-menu-does-not-cover-another rule. The only other priced source found, SinglePlatform (places.singleplatform.com/james-coffee-1/menu, address matches exactly: 2355 India Street, San Diego, CA 92101), has just 10 dishes across 5 sections (Breads & Pastries, Desserts, Cold, Hot, Macarons) with only 2 items per section including only 2 hot drinks (Cappuccino, Vanilla) and 2 cold drinks (Mexican Mocha, Mocha) for a full-service coffee roastery - no drip coffee, no americano, no espresso, no cold brew - which reads as a thin/partial legacy listing rather than the whole menu (playbook flags SinglePlatform for exactly this kind of silent truncation). Waiting for either the Little Italy reopening or a fuller priced source.
notes: Not marking not_found - this is a temporarily-closed, actively re-opening business, not a permanent closure. Re-check after the stated 2026 Little Italy reopening.

name: Molly's
notes: Own site (mollysmissionbeach.com) 403s on curl and its /menu page hits a Cloudflare challenge even via r.jina.ai, so this used the restaurants own first-party Toast storefront instead (address in the slug and on-page text both say 3770 Mission Blvd, matching work list). window.__OO_STATE__ held 7 full nested menus (Barista, Pastries, Regulars Menu, Breakfast, Lunch, Mollys PM, OPEN - To-Go Menu) totalling 244 rows, heavily overlapping across dayparts/ordering-channel menus (e.g. Barista and Regulars Menu share 39 of 43 items) - a Toast duplicate-catalog pattern, not a markup pattern. Deduped by name+price to 121 unique priced dishes across 20 sections (coffee/espresso, pastries, brunch, sandwiches, sides, martini hour, etc). 15 rows had no price in their specific menu instance but every one of them had a priced duplicate elsewhere in the catalog that is already included, so nothing was lost. No 3PO label found; checked for delivery-app markup by comparing same-named items across menus - only 2 of ~119 distinct names differ in price at all (Double Espresso .50/.75, Classic Croissant .50/.75), too small and inconsistent to be a markup, kept the first-seen value for each. This looks like the complete all-day menu (coffee bar through PM/martini hour).
